overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting the specific litigation case name from its August 25, 2021 notice for an executive session; it declined to review earlier notices raised only on further review.

allegations.summary: The August 25, 2021 notice said the Board would meet in executive session on pending litigation without naming the case, allegedly violating the notice requirements.
allegations.key_passage: We agree and find that the meeting notice should have included the name of the litigation matter that was to be discussed in executive session as such information would have better provided the public with an understanding of the precise subject of the executive session discussion without compromising the Board’s litigating position.

allegations.summary: The request for further review alleged that other Board notices from December 2019 to June 2021 also omitted specific litigation case names; the AG did not review this.
allegations.key_passage: We find that these allegations were not clearly raised in the original complaint and thus we do not review their merits.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
